text: The fourteen children and doubles have been accounted for. Which living account will the village receive? Your choice changes what evidence is shared, how much trust the families offer, and what burden follows you home.

options.label: Publish the verified evidence to the village and priory
options.when: (campaign.var.evidence_brugh_layout or campaign.var.evidence_gold_threads or campaign.var.evidence_arthur_double or campaign.var.evidence_fairy_mirrors or campaign.var.evidence_parent_suspicion) and (campaign.var.figwort_stance == 'protect' or campaign.var.figwort_stance == 'reconcile' or campaign.var.village_trust >= 1)

options.label: Protect frightened families with a private named account
Report an uncertain missing-child account with no proof
options.when: not campaign.var.evidence_brugh_layout and not campaign.var.evidence_gold_threads and not campaign.var.evidence_arthur_double and not campaign.var.evidence_fairy_mirrors and not campaign.var.evidence_parent_suspicion

options.label: Visit the village before choosing the final account
